description: Version tracking list and audit policy config. agent/scripts/watch-updates.mjs polls periodically: projects with releases are audited by release_mode (periodic=best-effort, audit only the latest release at detection time, skip intermediates). Projects without releases are NOT tracked (release-only list). Only the 20 highest-star currently audited plugins are enrolled (repo-deduped, one entry per repo). Metadata is read from _import/audit-queue/<id>.json; only id and policy are listed here.
description_zh: 版本追踪清单与审计策略配置。agent/scripts/watch-updates.mjs 定时检测：有 release 的项目按 release_mode 策略审计（periodic=尽力而为，只审检测时刻最新 release，中间跳过不补）；无 release 的项目不纳入追踪（release-only 列表）。仅纳入当前已上架插件中 star 排名前 20（按仓库去重，同仓只留一条）。元数据从 _import/audit-queue/<id>.json 读取，此处只列 id 与策略。
